cond.heavy_pain.title: Strong pain on several days
cond.heavy_pain.body: You logged pain of 7 or more on {cond_pain_days} days this cycle. A pain diary helps you and your doctor see the pattern.

cond.heavy_bleeding.title: Heavy flow on several days
cond.heavy_bleeding.body: You logged heavy flow on {cond_bleeding_days} days this cycle. The pad chart (PBAC) measures how much you bleed so it can be checked.
